rationale_overall: All five incumbents showed intact or strengthening trailing-quarter theses with no clean remove trigger: MSFT and NVDA sit at the center of the AI buildup (ChatGPT's Nov 30 2022 launch went viral within days and rides on Microsoft's existing OpenAI partnership; NVDA remains the core AI-compute name despite the Oct 7 2022 China export-control headwind, which trims addressable market but doesn't break the domestic AI thesis), LMT got a fresh tailwind from the FY23 NDAA's $857.9B defense budget and F-35 Lot 15/16 award signed into the pipeline in December, RKLB posted record Q3 revenue (+1,093% YoY) plus new DoD Tranche 1 Tracking Layer contract wins, and SMR (NuScale) added a Romania FEED contract showing early international traction for its SMR design. Quantum computing (IONQ: a $13.4M USAF trapped-ion contract and a new Bothell WA manufacturing facility announcement) surfaced as the strongest next-wave candidate this quarter, but at max_watchlist_size=5 no incumbent cleared a genuine remove trigger to pair with it, so no swap was forced. Robotics, tanker/freight, and eldercare/demographics discovery beats returned only generic sector-growth commentary with no dated, single-ticker catalyst in the Oct-Dec 2022 window, so none of those buckets produced an actionable add either.
